resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and European Portuguese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded European Portuguese pass identified 25 actionable formula, terminology, grammar, technical-clarity, and SI/AWG defects across electrical, circuit, TCR, trigonometric, thermal, heat-flux, and unit content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent European Portuguese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The relationship heading was a literal false-friend translation in European Portuguese.
evidence: The previous title was O relacionamento.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating summary said current transforms resistance into heat rather than electrical energy.
evidence: The previous summary was Como a corrente elétrica transforma a resistência em calor.
findings.resolution: Changed it to electrical energy being transformed into heat.

findings.summary: The Joule formula used spaced exponent notation instead of the protected formula form.
evidence: The previous expression used I ^ 2 and 3 ^ 2.

findings.summary: The coil setup used transporta for electrical current.
evidence: The previous text said the coil transports 3 A.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 3 A current flowing through the coil.

findings.summary: The constant-current bullet omitted the preposition needed for natural Portuguese.
evidence: The previous bullet began A corrente constante.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Com corrente constante.

findings.summary: The heating bullet used the English loanword hardware.
evidence: The previous text referred to ar, líquido e hardware.

findings.summary: The branch definition used caminho atual, which does not mean current path naturally in Portuguese.
evidence: The previous bullet used caminho atual entre dois nós.
findings.resolution: Changed it to caminho da corrente.

findings.summary: The KCL heading used Lei atual instead of the standard current-law term.
evidence: The previous title was Lei atual de Kirchhoff.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Lei das correntes de Kirchhoff.

findings.summary: The KCL formula used lowercase current notation.
evidence: The previous expression was Σ i = 0.

findings.summary: The KCL paragraph used direções atuais instead of directions of current.
evidence: The previous paragraph used Escolha as direções atuais.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with direções das correntes and natural node-flow wording.

findings.summary: The branch-current conclusion used transporta for current.
evidence: The previous conclusion said each branch transports 10 A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to each branch conducts 10 A.

findings.summary: The series-cell formula localized the protected series note.
evidence: The previous expression ended with (série).

findings.summary: The TCR example contained corrupted zero-width degree notation.
evidence: The previous setup rendered the 20 °C and ppm/°C values with malformed characters.

findings.summary: The TCR current formula omitted spaces around division.
evidence: The previous expression was I = V/R.

findings.summary: The TCR power formula used spaced exponent notation.
evidence: The previous expression used V ^ 2 and I ^ 2.
findings.resolution: Restored P = V^2 / R = I^2 × R.

findings.summary: The cosine formula localized the protected triangle-side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used cos(θ) = adjacente / hipotenusa.

findings.summary: The worked cosine formula localized the protected adjacent-side label.
evidence: The previous expression used adjacente.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name omitted the density/per-area meaning.
evidence: The previous name was Fluxo de calor.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Densidade do fluxo de calor.

findings.summary: The definition called q'' heat flux rather than heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous bullet used O fluxo de calor.
findings.resolution: Changed it to densidade do fluxo de calor in W/m².

findings.summary: The conduction explanation referred to flow of temperature instead of flow of heat.
evidence: The previous bullet said fluxo de temperatura.
findings.resolution: Changed it to fluxo de calor.

findings.summary: The practical-check list mixed an infinitive with imperative instructions.
evidence: The previous bullet began Distinguir.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the direct imperative Distinga.

findings.summary: The SI length row used medidor, which means gauge/metering device rather than the unit metre.
evidence: The previous row used medidor.

findings.summary: The SI mass row was corrupted by the unrelated word Missa.
evidence: The previous row used Missa instead of Massa.

findings.summary: The milli prefix symbol was translated as the Portuguese word eu.
evidence: The previous row used eu for 10^-3.

findings.summary: The AWG formula localized the protected inch variable.
evidence: The previous expression used d_polegada.
